details: Bitcoin is currently stabilizing around $83,600, despite experiencing $681.10 million in net outflows from institutional spot ETFs last week, ending a three-week inflow streak. Analysts are closely watching the $85,000 level as a crucial resistance point for potential structural market changes, while short-term predictions suggest potential trading between $81,282 and $84,974 in the next 24 hours.
title: Bitcoin Price Holds Above $83,000 Amid ETF Outflows

details: Ethereum has declined by 0.70% in the last 24 hours, generally underperforming against the broader CD20 index, which fell 1.98%. Ethereum-linked exchange-traded products, such as ETHA, saw a 5.6% decline, and Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs have experienced a combined $1.2 billion in institutional outflows recently. This trend suggests investors are moving towards the relative safety of Bitcoin within the digital asset ecosystem.
title: Ethereum Underperforms as ETF Outflows Continue

details: Robinhood Chain has surpassed Hyperliquid in 24-hour decentralized exchange (DEX) volume, processing over $560 million. This highlights growing activity on permissionless, AI-native Layer 2 blockchains in the DeFi space.
title: Robinhood Chain Flips Hyperliquid in DEX Volume

details: NFT sales reached $39.85 million over the seven days to October 10th, marking a 0.90% increase from the previous week. Ethereum maintained its lead in blockchain for NFTs, and sales of Pudgy Penguins notably more than doubled. However, the broader NFT market has seen a 13% drop in daily sales volume to $42.1 million.
title: NFT Sales See Mixed Performance, Pudgy Penguins Jump

details: Thailand is preparing to open its stock exchange to crypto funds, aiming to participate in the $120 billion Bitcoin and Ethereum ETF market. However, the country plans to implement its own terms, restricting retail access to competing foreign products.
title: Thailand Eyes $120 Billion Crypto ETF Market
